text.2:50: And when We brought you through the sea and rescued you, and drowned the folk of Pharaoh in your sight.
text.6:63: Say: Who delivereth you from the darkness of the land and the sea? Ye call upon Him humbly and in secret, (saying): If we are delivered from this (fear) we truly will be of the thankful.
text.7:64: But they denied him, so We saved him and those with him in the ship, and We drowned those who denied Our tokens. Lo! they were blind folk.
text.7:72: And We saved him and those with him by a mercy from Us, and We cut the root of those who denied Our revelations and were not believers.
text.7:83: And We rescued him and his household, save his wife, who was of those who stayed behind.
text.7:141: And (remember) when We did deliver you from Pharaoh's folk who were afflicting you with dreadful torment, slaughtering your sons and sparing your women. That was a tremendous trial from your Lord.
text.7:165: And when they forgot that whereof they had been reminded, We rescued those who forbade wrong, and visited those who did wrong with dreadful punishment because they were evil-livers.
text.10:22: He it is Who maketh you to go on the land and the sea till, when ye are in the ships and they sail with them with a fair breeze and they are glad therein, a storm-wind reacheth them and the wave cometh unto them from every side and they deem that they are overwhelmed therein; (then) they cry unto Allah, making their faith pure for Him only: If Thou deliver us from this, we truly will be of the thankful.
text.10:23: Yet when He hath delivered them, behold! they rebel in the earth wrongfully. O mankind! Your rebellion is only against yourselves. (Ye have) enjoyment of the life of the world; then unto Us is your return and We shall proclaim unto you what ye used to do.
text.10:103: Then shall We save Our messengers and the believers, in like manner (as of old). It is incumbent upon Us to save believers.
text.11:116: If only there had been among the generations before you men possessing a remnant (of good sense) to warn (their people) from corruption in the earth, as did a few of those whom We saved from them! The wrong-doers followed that by which they were made sapless, and were guilty.
text.14:6: And (remind them) how Moses said unto his people: Remember Allah's favour unto you when He delivered you from Pharaoh's folk who were afflicting you with dreadful torment, and were slaying your sons and sparing your women; that was a tremendous trial from your Lord.
text.20:80: O Children of Israel! We delivered you from your enemy, and we made a covenant with you on the holy mountain's side, and sent down on you the manna and the quails,
text.21:9: Then we fulfilled the promise unto them. So we delivered them and whom We would, and We destroyed the prodigals.
text.21:88: Then we heard his prayer and saved him from the anguish. Thus we save believers.
text.26:65: And We saved Moses and those with him, every one;
text.26:119: And We saved him and those with him in the laden ship.
text.27:53: And we saved those who believed and used to ward off (evil).
text.27:57: Then We saved him and his household save his wife; We destined her to be of those who stayed behind.
text.29:15: And We rescued him and those with him in the ship, and made of it a portent for the peoples.
text.29:24: But the answer of his folk was only that they said: "Kill him" or "Burn him." Then Allah saved him from the Fire. Lo! herein verily are portents for folk who believe.
text.61:10: O ye who believe! Shall I show you a commerce that will save you from a painful doom?
text.70:14: And all that are in the earth, if then it might deliver him.
